NameLEss 11/20/2025 12:41 PM
year 1, everything in savings, year 2 everything in CDs, if something comes up that you owe, just keep the screen up until you get your pocket money. Year 3, everything in index, year 4 start watching stocks, put some money in one of the cheaper ones that has been going down, if it keeps going down, keep adding money to lower your cost basis, sometimes ill take everything out of index to put it into a poor performing stock, then just hold forever until it profits by a lot. I try to have my score beat by year 15 or so, and keep an eye on CD rates because if you're near your highest score and you have 8%+ on your 3 year CD then put 100% of it in there.
